title_en: Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Grassroots Construction of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Strengthening the Grassroots Construction of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2000] No. 17

Focusing on grassroots construction and placing the emphasis and effort on the grassroots level is the key to comprehensively strengthening and improving the work of people's courts. This is of great significance for people's courts at all levels to adapt to the needs of the continuous deepening of reform, opening up, and socialist modernization, to fully perform their adjudicative functions, to ensure judicial fairness, to better serve the overall work of the Party and the State, and to advance the implementation of the basic strategy of governing the country according to law. People's courts at all levels must be guided by General Secretary Jiang Zemin's important thought of the "Three Represents," and with an attitude of high responsibility towards the Party, the people, and history, comprehensively strengthen the grassroots construction of people's courts.

I. Overall Goals and Principles of Grassroots Construction of People's Courts

1. In the rapid development of socialist democracy and legal construction in our country, grassroots people's courts have made significant achievements in trial work, team building, and judicial reform. For a long time, grassroots people's courts have actively overcome various difficulties, carried out work creatively, accumulated much experience, and enriched the theory and practice of people's judicial work under the conditions of reform, opening up, and the development of the socialist market economy. Facts have proven that grassroots people's courts and the vast majority of people's judges can adhere to the principles of the Constitution and laws, safeguard the dignity of the national legal system, satisfactorily complete trial and enforcement tasks, and have made important contributions to maintaining social stability, promoting economic development, and ensuring the well-being of the broad masses of the people. However, it must be clearly recognized that with the development and changes in the objective situation, people's courts, especially grassroots people's courts, do have problems and difficulties in terms of judicial standards, team quality, management methods, and material equipment construction that are not adapted to the profound changes in the economy, society, ideology, and culture. People's courts at all levels must attach great importance to this, face the seriousness of the problems existing in grassroots construction, and in accordance with the Central Committee's requirements for strengthening the construction of political and legal teams, vigorously strengthen the grassroots construction of people's courts with a reform-oriented spirit.

2. The overall goal of strengthening grassroots construction of people's courts for the current and future period is: adhere to the guidance of Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, and General Secretary Jiang Zemin's important thought of the "Three Represents," conscientiously implement the basic strategy of governing the country according to law, vigorously promote various reforms of the people's courts, strive to use about two years to comprehensively strengthen the leadership teams of grassroots people's courts, significantly improve the overall quality of the judge contingent, make new progress in judicial reform, significantly improve the quality and efficiency of trials, substantially improve material equipment construction, and gradually build grassroots people's courts into modern adjudicative organs that meet the needs of economic development and social progress.

3. To vigorously strengthen grassroots construction of people's courts, it is necessary to further strengthen reform awareness, fully recognize the importance, necessity, and urgency of reform, and continuously promote judicial reform; it is necessary to base ourselves on the present, look to the long term, start from solving overall problems, and make overall plans; it is necessary to adhere to the mass line, fully mobilize the initiative, enthusiasm, and creativity of judges and other staff; it is necessary to adhere to the work style of seeking truth from facts and pragmatism, implement classified guidance, avoid a "one-size-fits-all" approach, oppose formalism, red tape, and false exaggeration, and ensure that various specific measures for strengthening grassroots construction of people's courts are truly implemented and achieve practical results.

II. Strengthening Ideological and Political Construction in Grassroots People's Courts

4. Conscientiously study and comprehend the spirit of General Secretary Jiang Zemin's important speech delivered at the Central Conference on Ideological and Political Work, fully recognize the important position and role of ideological and political work, clarify the tasks of the Party's ideological and political work in the new era, unify ideological understanding with the spirit of the Central Committee, and further strengthen and improve ideological and political work in grassroots people's courts. It is necessary to firmly establish a sense of innovation, actively expand the space for ideological and political work, and effectively make the ideological and political work of the people's courts lively, practical, and effective.

5. In combination with the actual work of trials, to strengthen and improve ideological and political work, it is necessary to correctly handle three relationships: the relationship between the legal effect and the social effect of handling cases; the relationship between national interests and personal interests; and the relationship between strict law enforcement and enthusiastic service.

6. To strengthen and improve ideological and political work in people's courts, it is necessary to adhere to the Party's leadership over ideological and political work. A responsibility system for ideological and political work shall be established and perfected, implementing dual responsibilities for one post, with each level grasping the next and ensuring implementation layer by layer, bringing ideological and political work to the frontline of trials; new mechanisms for carrying out ideological and political work shall be established and perfected, leveraging the advantages of combined coordination and management such as combining personnel management with task management, educating judges and other staff to truly achieve self-examination, self-respect, and self-discipline, and strengthening their own personality, character, and moral cultivation; the incentive and restraining role of ideological and political work shall be strengthened, continuously enhancing its appeal and penetration.

7. The Party's and the State's lines, principles, and policies shall be promptly implemented in the various work of grassroots people's courts to ensure that people's courts maintain a high degree of political consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Jiang Zemin at its core. Scientific theories and excellent culture shall be used to educate judges and other staff to firmly establish correct worldviews, outlooks on life, and values, to solve the fundamental issues of for whom to hold power, for whom to enforce the law, and for whom to serve, and to lay a solid ideological foundation for ensuring judicial fairness.

8. The professional ethics construction of judges shall be taken as an important task of ideological and political work, cultivating high professional ethics and strict self-discipline awareness among judges and other staff; ideological education shall be combined with caring for and solving practical problems in the lives of judges and other staff, and protecting their legitimate rights and interests, to enhance team cohesion; closely centering on trial work, new ways and methods of ideological and political work shall be constantly explored to enhance pertinence, effectiveness, and initiative, gradually forming a new pattern of ideological and political work.

III. Strengthening Organizational Construction of Grassroots People's Courts

9. Strengthening leadership team construction is the top priority of strengthening grassroots organization construction of people's courts. The main criteria for comprehensively strengthening leadership teams of grassroots people's courts are: high political and professional quality, integrity and self-discipline, strict law enforcement, good exemplary and leading role, strong sense of reform and innovation, good at carrying out ideological and political work, and strong cohesion and combat effectiveness.

10. Fully implement various regulations and measures of the Supreme People's Court on strengthening the construction of leadership teams of grassroots people's courts. The president of a grassroots people's court shall be recommended from among persons who meet the qualifications for judges; vice presidents shall be selected from outstanding judges; in principle, the leadership team shall include one young cadre about 35 years old with more than five years of trial practice experience. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall actively cooperate with the Organization Departments of local Party committees, and before the end of 2001, conduct a comprehensive inspection and adjustment of the leadership teams of grassroots people's courts. The Supreme People's Court will, together with relevant departments, inspect the situation of the inspection and adjustment.

11. Members of the leadership teams of grassroots people's courts shall further improve their own political and professional quality, pay attention to leadership art, and enhance work ability. They shall firmly establish the awareness of independently and impartially exercising adjudicative power according to law, resolutely resist various illegal interventions, and adjudicate cases according to law.

12. Strengthen the training and development of presiding judges of people's tribunals. Before the end of this year, each grassroots people's court shall conduct a comprehensive inspection and adjustment of the presiding judges of the people's tribunals under its jurisdiction. Outstanding judges shall be selected to serve as presiding judges of people's tribunals, and people's tribunals shall be regarded as important bases for training court leadership cadres and professional backbone personnel. Attention shall be paid to selecting leadership cadres from among presiding judges of people's tribunals.

13. Improve the personnel recruitment and elimination system for grassroots people's courts. Implement the principle of "entry must be through examination" and strictly control the entry gate. From 2001 onwards, except as provided by national policies, the recruitment of personnel into grassroots people's courts shall implement a system of unified examination questions by the Supreme People's Court, unified examinations by higher people's courts, and recruitment. Persons to be recruited shall undergo training in judicial skills and professional requirements for judges at judge training institutions before working in grassroots people's courts. Henceforth, any personnel who have entered the court without following national policies or without passing the unified examination shall be removed. For existing unqualified personnel in grassroots people's courts, cleanup work shall be effectively completed in accordance with the requirements of the Supreme People's Court Fa Fa [1999] No. 15 "Notice on Further Cleaning Up and Removing Personnel Unfit for Court Work."

14. Deepen the reform of the personnel system and establish competition and incentive mechanisms. Before the end of 2001, grassroots people's courts shall complete the selection and appointment of presiding judges and sole judges. Persons who are not selected as presiding judges or sole judges shall be assigned appropriate work according to their moral and talent conditions. On this basis, promptly complete the work of fixing the number of judges together with relevant departments.

15. Continue to conduct pilot projects on the management of the separate sequence of positions for court clerks, laying the foundation for the comprehensive establishment of this system in 2001. To address the current shortage of court clerks in grassroots people's courts, stenographers may be recruited on a temporary basis to undertake court record work.

16. Actively explore the reform of the appointment system for judicial police, smooth the entry and exit channels for judicial police, and pilot a system of employing some judicial police on a contract basis to alleviate the shortage of police force in grassroots people's courts.

17. Conscientiously implement the Supreme People's Court Fa Fa [2000] No. 1 "Regulations on Strengthening Investigation and Research Work in People's Courts," establish and perfect investigation and research institutions in grassroots people's courts, and actively carry out effective research activities. Research personnel who meet the conditions for appointment to adjudicative positions shall be appointed to adjudicative positions.

18. Continue to implement the system of appointing presidents of grassroots people's courts to serve in different localities and the exchange and rotation of other judges. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall, adhering to the principle of "maintaining basic stability and promoting reasonable mobility," carry out this work under the leadership of local Party committees, and propose specific time and condition requirements based on actual circumstances. In principle, judge exchanges shall be conducted within the court system in different localities or between higher and lower level courts. Rotation shall not affect trial work. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall periodically inspect the implementation of this system to prevent it from being a mere formality.

19. In accordance with the requirements of the laws governing trial work, scientifically set up internal institutions in grassroots people's courts. In conjunction with the institutional reform of grassroots people's courts, higher people's courts shall clearly define the scope of responsibilities of internal institutions in the grassroots people's courts under their jurisdiction, changing the current situation of overlapping functions and unclear division of labor. Reasonably adjust the ratio of trial personnel to administrative personnel, and strengthen and reinforce trial business institutions.

20. Grassroots people's courts shall reasonably set up people's tribunals in accordance with standardization requirements. By the end of 2000, the adjustment of the establishment of people's tribunals shall be fully completed.

21. People's tribunals shall establish Party organizations in accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall, in cooperation with local Party committees, combine the implementation of rectification measures from the "Three Emphases" education, and use about two years to conduct a comprehensive inspection of Party building work in grassroots people's courts. Starting from perfecting the construction of grassroots Party organizations, the important thought of the "Three Represents" shall be implemented in every grassroots Party branch and every Party member, so that the Party organizations of grassroots people's courts truly become strong bastions.

22. Higher-level people's courts shall actively create conditions and take effective measures to help improve the working and living conditions of judges in grassroots people's courts. Systems such as personal injury insurance for judges during the execution of official duties shall be quickly established and implemented.

IV. Strengthening Professional Construction of Grassroots People's Courts

23. Strengthen the awareness of the overall situation and fair justice, implement the guiding ideology of serving the overall situation in various trial work, and ensure correct adjudication.

24. Grassroots people's courts shall, in accordance with the requirements of the trial quality indicator system stipulated in the Supreme People's Court Fa [1999] No. 229 Notice, carry out routine inspections of trial quality. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall conduct regular or irregular inspections of grassroots people's courts or organize cross-inspections to ensure trial quality from an institutional and mechanistic perspective.

25. Deeply promote the reform of trial methods, strengthen the responsibilities of collegial panels, presiding judges, and sole judges, promote the separation of complex and simple cases, expand the scope of application of summary procedures according to law, strengthen mediation work according to law, and improve trial efficiency. Promote the trial process management system and establish a scientific and modern trial management operation mechanism. Each grassroots people's court shall, before the end of this year, establish a system for reporting the trial time limits of cases tried by the court, implement a method for tracking time limits after case filing, and achieve a virtuous cycle of case receipt and conclusion by 2001, basically solving the problem of exceeding time limits.

26. Conscientiously implement the principle of "three separations" (separation of case filing, trial, and enforcement). Grassroots people's courts that have not implemented separation or have not implemented it properly shall implement it as soon as possible. The issue of implementing "separation of case filing and trial" in people's tribunals shall be properly resolved based on actual conditions, benefiting fairness, convenience for litigation, and efficiency.

27. Improve the quality of adjudicative documents. Adjudicative documents for cases concluded by ordinary procedures shall emphasize reasoning and argumentation; adjudicative documents for cases concluded by summary procedures or mediation shall strive to be concise and clear. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall conscientiously inspect the quality of adjudicative documents from grassroots people's courts.

28. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall, in accordance with the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning People's Tribunals" and in light of local actual conditions, formulate implementation measures, strengthen guidance and supervision over the work of people's tribunals, and resolutely correct the practice of some people's tribunals participating in administrative law enforcement activities.

29. Continue to vigorously address the "difficulty in enforcement," and strive to achieve a dynamic balance in the receipt and conclusion of enforcement cases. Higher people's courts shall promptly establish and perfect a new mechanism for unified management and coordination of enforcement work, and ensure the normal operation of this mechanism. They shall strengthen guidance, supervision, coordination, and management of entrusted enforcement work by grassroots people's courts under their jurisdiction, clearly define the management responsibilities of intermediate and grassroots people's courts for enforcement work, and form a new pattern of enforcement work with entrusted enforcement as the main form. Further standardize the enforcement work of people's tribunals. In principle, people's tribunals are only responsible for enforcing adjudicative documents of simple civil and economic cases that have been concluded by them and have become legally effective and contain content for payment. Non-litigation administrative cases and complex, difficult cases shall be enforced by the grassroots people's court.

30. Adopt various forms to strengthen professional training. Higher people's courts shall establish judge training institutions before the end of 2001, and before the end of 2002, generally conduct a rotational training for all judges of grassroots people's courts. Grassroots people's courts shall also, based on the characteristics and actual needs of their own work, use various forms such as inviting experts and scholars to give lectures, conducting trial observations, and discussing difficult cases to carry out professional study and trial skills training activities. The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts shall formulate special plans for professional training of grassroots people's courts in western and impoverished areas, and take effective measures to implement them.

31. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall strengthen guidance and support for the allocation of library materials in grassroots people's courts. Each grassroots people's court shall establish a library and equip it with the professional books and materials needed for handling cases.

V. Strengthening Discipline and Work Style Construction of Grassroots People's Courts

32. Continue to carry out the activities of "Strive to Be a People's Satisfied Court, Strive to Be a People's Satisfied Judge," strengthen the awareness of serving the people wholeheartedly and the awareness of civilized law enforcement. Start with things that satisfy the people, correct things that do not satisfy the people, adhere to fair and civilized law enforcement, correct bad styles such as "cold, hard, horizontal, push," and establish a good image of the people's court and people's judges.

33. Conscientiously implement the "Several Provisions on the Strict Implementation of the Withdrawal System by Trial Personnel." Each grassroots people's court shall establish files of persons who should withdraw within the court, and may, when necessary, disclose them to the public to strengthen self-supervision and social supervision. Cases tried in violation of the withdrawal provisions shall be retried according to law.

34. Implement a system of mutual cooperation between the discipline inspection and supervision departments of the people's court and the trial supervision department in investigating and handling cases of illegal and disciplinary violations. Strictly in accordance with the provisions of the "Measures for Investigating the Responsibility for Illegal Adjudication by Trial Personnel of People's Courts (Trial Implementation)" and the "Measures for the Imposition of Disciplinary Sanctions on Trial Personnel of People's Courts (Trial Implementation)," resolutely pursue the responsibility of relevant personnel. Each intermediate people's court shall periodically inspect the implementation of the two "Measures" by the grassroots people's courts under its jurisdiction, and report the inspection results to the higher people's court once every six months. For courts where the implementation of the two "Measures" is ineffective, resulting in serious consequences, the higher people's court shall pursue the responsibility of relevant leaders. The leadership responsibility system for self-criticism shall be strictly implemented.

35. Grassroots people's courts shall implement the responsibility system for clean government construction documents before the end of 2000. Discipline inspection and supervision departments shall regularly carry out integrity education, promote and implement various effective integrity supervision work systems, strengthen supervision over leadership teams, especially the top leader, and promote clean government construction.

VI. Strengthening Material Equipment Construction of Grassroots People's Courts

36. To meet the needs of trial method reform, grassroots people's courts shall promptly carry out renovation, expansion, and facility matching work for courtrooms. Higher-level people's courts shall, in response to the outstanding difficulties faced by grassroots people's courts in western impoverished areas in the construction of the two courts (courtrooms and office buildings), especially the renovation and expansion of courtrooms, increase assistance efforts.

37. Within three years, basically achieve the application of modern technical means such as computers in trial management, court records, production of litigation documents, court personnel management, file management, judicial statistics, information processing, etc.

38. Strictly implement various policy measures for ensuring court business expenses after the implementation of "separate revenue and expenditure lines." Higher and intermediate people's courts shall actively coordinate with relevant local government departments to ensure the funding guarantee for grassroots people's courts. Grassroots people's courts shall give full play to their subjective initiative, seek support in funding from Party committees, people's congresses, and relevant government departments, and ensure the smooth progress of trial work.

VII. Strengthening Guidance, Changing Work Style, and Emphasizing Implementation

39. Leaders of people's courts at all levels shall often go deep into the grassroots to conduct investigations and research, establish contact points in grassroots people's courts and people's tribunals, spend time each year conducting on-site inspections, and help solve practical problems. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen forward-looking research on issues that may arise in grassroots construction, accurately grasp the situation and trends, and put forward targeted opinions and suggestions.

40. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall formulate specific plans and measures for strengthening grassroots construction, assign tasks and responsibilities to individuals, and effectively strengthen guidance and supervision over various tasks in grassroots construction. Grassroots people's courts must resolutely implement various decisions of higher-level people's courts on strengthening grassroots construction. People's courts at all levels must firmly establish the thinking of the national courts as "one game of chess," be united from top to bottom, and form a joint force. Effectively in accordance with the requirements of General Secretary Jiang Zemin's important thought of the "Three Represents," under the leadership of the Party, the supervision of the People's Congress, and the support of the government, achieve the goal of making significant progress in the grassroots construction of people's courts in about two years, and strive to create a new situation in the grassroots work of people's courts.

August 13, 2000
